name: Breast Cancer
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of suffering and trials, offering believers assurance that God is a present help and refuge in times of trouble. Even when facing the shadow of death, such as with serious illnesses like breast cancer, we are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting that the Lord will not forsake us. The Psalms remind us that God is near to the brokenhearted and heals through His word, providing comfort and deliverance amid distress.
